hero.tagline: I build fast, secure and polished web applications.

nexoraModal.title: Glad you're interested! 😄
nexoraModal.body: Nexora isn't open source — it's a commercial product. But I'll be happy to tell you more:

nexora.name: Nexora
nexora.desc: A cloud ERP (SaaS) for beauty salons with a multi-brand franchise model. Planned documentation-first — vision, business rules and use cases — and executed through verified milestones all the way to deployment: scheduling, touch POS, certified legal invoicing (VeriFactu · Spanish Tax Agency), cash management, inventory, time tracking and reports, plus a WhatsApp AI receptionist, automatic restocking and marketing campaigns.

front.title: Frontend
front.desc: Angular 20 SPA (signals, standalone components) with 58 components and a custom CSS design system.

back.title: Backend
back.desc: REST API built with NestJS 11: 30 modules, 45 services and 192 endpoints on PostgreSQL with Prisma and Redis.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.desc: WhatsApp Cloud API with an AI receptionist (Claude), VeriFactu legal invoicing against the Spanish Tax Agency, ESC/POS thermal printing and email.

security.title: Cybersecurity
security.desc: JWT auth with token rotation, 104-permission RBAC, strict multi-tenant isolation, AES-256-GCM encryption of sensitive data, append-only audit log and operational GDPR.

inefable.name: Estética Inefable
inefable.desc: Corporate website for a beauty salon, built with WordPress, including hosting management.

psecurewd.name: PSecureWD
psecurewd.desc: My Higher Technician final project: a mobile password manager — a React Native (Expo) app with 8 screens, Google sign-in, a password generator and an Express + MySQL API. My first complete full stack project, the starting point for everything since.

origen.desc: Full stack development of web applications: Angular on the frontend with .NET and Node.js backends.

inetum.desc: ABAP development on SAP across the finance and logistics modules: debugging and fixing existing programs, and building new ones.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a full stack developer, trained in multi-platform application development and holding a master's degree in cybersecurity. I got into this field out of curiosity — wanting to understand how things work on the inside — and that curiosity still drives my work: I enjoy building a polished interface just as much as securing the layer users never see.
about.p2: I've worked in SAP consulting, in full stack development in the biotech sector, and on personal projects — among them Nexora, a cloud ERP built end to end. Each stage taught me something different: the rigour of corporate environments, the versatility of product work, and the discipline of taking an idea all the way to production.
about.p3: I enjoy working in a team, listening before giving my opinion, and anticipating problems before they appear. If I had to sum myself up in one sentence: I'm a calm, consistent person, eager to keep learning from every team I'm part of.

e2e.title: End-to-end development
e2e.desc: I can take a product from idea to production: architecture, database, API, UI, tests and deployment. Backed by Nexora: 30 modules, 49 tables and 532 automated tests.

security.title: Applied cybersecurity
security.desc: A cybersecurity master's degree put into practice: token-rotation authentication, AES-256-GCM encryption, granular RBAC, audit logging and operational GDPR. Self-audited: 14 findings, 14 resolved.

drive.title: Autonomy & drive
drive.desc: From learning a technology to shipping it in production without intermediaries: documentation first, recorded decisions, and quality that is verified — not declared.

contact.title: Contact
contact.heading: Let's talk
contact.text: I'm open to new opportunities and projects. Drop me an email and I'll get back to you as soon as possible.
